title: Lamb, Rosemary and Sweet Potato Pie
description: Diced lamb simmered with tomatoes, carrots and mushrooms, topped with mashed sweet potato and grated cheese, then baked until golden.

ingredients.text: 450g leg of lamb, diced, any visible fat removed
300ml beef stock (1 beef stock pot dissolved in 300ml boiling water)
900g sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Spray a medium saucepan with low-calorie cooking spray, place on a medium heat and fry the onion for 5 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and fry for 1–2 minutes.
Add the lamb and fry for 1–2 minutes on all sides to seal.
Add the stock, tomato puree, drained chopped tomatoes, carrots, mushrooms and rosemary.
Cover and  simmer on a low heat for 45 minutes–1 hour, or until the lamb is tender.
While the lamb is cooking, cook the sweet potatoes in boiling water for 20 minutes or until tender.
Drain the sweet potatoes and mash with the egg yolk until smooth.
When the lamb is tender, place in the bottom of a 18cm x 27cm (roughly 7in x 10½in) ovenproof dish.
Spread the mashed sweet potato over the lamb mixture and sprinkle with cheese.
Place in the hot oven and bake for 15–20 minutes until lightly browned.
